status: frozen before any sweep measurement (location or 1k); deviations go to addendum files
evidence_class: development evidence: ImageNet screen-1k list (imagenet_screen_1k), first 128 images for the location phase, images 0-1000 for the grid. No held-out image is run.

engine.command: artifacts/agent_orchestration/gpu_run.sh --min-free-mib 3000 --wait 7200 $A/run.sh predict CASE POLICY cuda START STOP --batch 8
engine.contract: scaled bridge contract 2.1 (docs/analysis/scaled-bridge-v2-contract-2026-10-01.md); policy names are complete specifications
engine.reuse: a result on images [0, N) is assembled from contiguous sealed predict files of the same case and policy (existing 32- and 64-image files and the 128-image location files included); the engine is exact and batch invariant, checked in step 1 (64-image file equals the 32-image file on its first 32 images).

excluded_cases.reason: not yet exported or gated when this protocol was frozen (one B2 export/replay at a time; GPU memory). It enters through addendum 1 with exactly these rules (case_spec of tools/accumulator_sweep_v1/protocol.py) if its MB2 gate and four policy gates pass; L1 kept no per-image B2 predictions for it, so its replay is checked against the L1 matrix readout (top5_topk) instead of retained Top-5.

policies.sat.w<W>: uniform family: signed saturating register of W bits at every MAC node
policies.sat.struct-<d>: per-node family: certified structural width of the node minus d
policies.float: fp16.x<e>, f21.x<e> (one rounding per multiply-add; binary point moved by e)

float_exponent_rule.ub: max over MAC nodes of bit_length(max_abs_prefix_units) - product_shift (certificate.json); every prefix sum satisfies |sum| < 2^ub in code-level units
float_exponent_rule.rule: e = 0 (plain policy name) when the plain format is proven overflow-free (ub <= emax) and every product step 2^-product_shift is a normal number (>= 2^emin); otherwise e = emax - ub, the largest shift the certificate proves overflow-free. fp16: emax 15, emin -14; f21: 127, -126. Implemented in tools/accumulator_sweep_v1/certs.py (unit tested).
float_exponent_rule.sensitivity_location_phase: cases int8-b2, fp7_e3m3-b2, posit8_es1-b2 (one integer, one minifloat, one posit; coarsened for the budget), 128 images: fp16.x<e+k> for k in [-3, 3]; f21.x<15-ub> next to the rule policy (expected identical to plain f21: no overflow, no subnormal)

location_phase.runs: every case: wide; sat.w ladder W_cert_abs-2, then every 3 bits downward (at most 12 rungs), launched in descending order and stopped once a finished rung has expected Top-1 <= half of wide (rungs already started are kept). B2 cases also: the rule fp16 and f21 policies and the exponent sensitivity runs.
location_phase.bracket_rule: top = narrowest rung W such that no rung >= W has a saturation event on the 128 images (W_cert_abs - 1 if the widest rung has one); bottom = (widest rung with expected Top-1 <= half of wide) - 2 (narrowest rung - 2 if none reached half); clipped to [2, W_cert_abs - 1] (tools/accumulator_sweep_v1/plan.py: bracket).

per_case.priority_1: wide; sat.w<W> for every integer W in [bottom, top]
per_case.priority_2: control; the rule fp16 and f21 policies (B2 cases)
per_case.priority_3: integer cases: sat.w<W> for W in [16, 20, 24, 28, 32] below the bracket and at or below W_cert_abs
per_case.priority_5: original-recipe (b1) cases: wide and the uniform bracket (recipe-sensitivity check)

extension_rules: top: while the 1k run at the widest bracket width has any saturation event, add the next wider width (below W_cert_abs)
bottom: while fewer than 2 bracket widths lie below W_half (1k), or no width reached half, add the next narrower width (down to 2)
screen_grid.hardware_widths_above_bracket: not run: a width above a width with no saturation event on the same 1000 images gives the exact arm bit for bit (no prefix sum leaves the narrower register, so none leaves the wider one); reported as derived
screen_grid.order: priority-major across cases (B2 cases in the listed order), at most 3 jobs of this lane at a time, resumable runner tools/run/accumulator_sweep_run.py

definitions_uniform_family.W_noevent: narrowest measured W from which upward no saturation event occurs on any of the 1000 images
definitions_uniform_family.W_same: narrowest W from which upward all 1000 lowest-index Top-1 classes equal the exact arm (a failed image counts as changed)
definitions_uniform_family.W_acc(0.5), W_acc(1.0): narrowest W from which upward the expected-credit Top-1 is at least the exact arm minus 0.5 / 1.0 points
definitions_uniform_family.W_half: widest W at which expected-credit Top-1 is at most half of the exact arm
definitions_uniform_family.from_upward: the condition holds at W and at every measured wider width of the bracket; widths above the bracket top equal the exact arm when the top has no event

definitions_per_node_family: d_noevent, d_same, d_acc(0.5), d_acc(1.0) = largest d from which downward (d smaller) the condition holds over the measured d set (0 = lossless by the gate); d_half = smallest measured d at or below half. Coarse: only the measured d values.

statistics.scores: expected credit (1/t when the label is among t tied maxima, failed image 0) and lowest-index Top-1 (contract tie order)
statistics.paired: every policy against wide of the same case on the same images: tools.analysis.b2_ties.paired (expected credit) and tools.analysis.b_stage_balanced_comparisons.paired_outcomes (lowest index), 95% paired bootstrap intervals
statistics.counts: images with a changed Top-1 class, with an accumulator event, failed; per-node event rates (share of images, share of outputs) at the widths around the transition
statistics.no_multiplicity_claims: descriptive development evidence; no hypothesis is confirmed here

by_product: exact wide arm against the B2 simulator's sealed 1k predictions (stage-1 per-image files or the L1 matrix readout), both tie rules, every B2 case that has them
join: integer cases: Top-1 at hardware widths 16-32 beside core area from results/tables/ics55-integer-accwidth-v1.csv at the 8 ns target (all configurations meet it); preliminary (hardware sweep unreviewed, RTL work on hold); semantic differences listed

budget.timing_basis: step 1 smoke test, shared GPU at 100% use by other lanes: 64 images in 16.9 s of execution at batch 8 (0.26 s per image), 50 s wall including about 33 s of setup; batch-1 full-trace gate panels ran at 0.45-0.6 s per image at the same time. Indicative only.
budget.location_runs: about 100 (10 per case; in-bracket ones are reused by the 1k runs)
budget.rule: The location phase is already coarsened (ladder step 3 plus a two-width refinement; exponent sensitivity on three cases only). Priorities 1 and 2 are run in full whatever the cost (the 1k bracket is not coarsened). Priorities 3 to 6 are run only while the cumulative GPU job time of this lane (wall_seconds of its predict calls in the engine ledger) stays below 5 hours; whatever is not run is listed as deferred for the owner. At an uncontended rate of about 0.1 s per image the whole grid would take about 5.5 hours.
